extDescription.message: Listen to Turkish news articles on any site with one click. The AI voice runs entirely on your device: free and private.

menuReadPage.message: Listen to this page with İstima

statusEnded.message: Finished · press play to listen again

statusError.message: Could not generate speech. Please try again.

popupNoneText.message: Select any text and right-click “Listen to selection with İstima”.

popupRestrictedText.message: Browser pages and the extension store can't be read. Open a news site.

popupNoArticle.message: No readable text found on this page.

popupPrivate.message: Your text never leaves your device

optionsTagline.message: Listen to Turkish news. Speech is generated entirely on your device.

optSpeedHint.message: You can also change it from the player while reading.

optHighlightHint.message: Shows which part of the page is being read.

optAutoScrollHint.message: Scrolls the page to the paragraph being read.

optAutoPlayHint.message: Starts reading as soon as a Turkish article opens.

optShowButtonHint.message: A small button appears in the corner of pages with a Turkish article.

optPositionHint.message: Which corner should the button and player use?

optSitesHint.message: The button won't appear on these sites; you can still read them from the toolbar icon.

optTryHint.message: Type any Turkish text; numbers, dates and abbreviations are read correctly.

optTrySample.message: İstanbul'da bugün hava parçalı bulutlu olacak; sıcaklığın 14 ile 21 derece arasında seyretmesi bekleniyor. Meteoroloji, akşam saatlerinde kuzey ilçelerde sağanak yağış uyarısında bulundu.

optAltClick.message: Tip: Alt-click any paragraph to start reading from there.

optPrivacy.message: İstima uses no server. The article text is processed entirely on your computer by the bundled AI model; no text, audio or usage data is ever sent anywhere.

optCredits.message: Voice: Antalia-2 Mini (PatientDesk AI, Apache-2.0), EMA Lightning (Canberk Aslan, Apache-2.0). Runtime: ONNX Runtime Web (MIT). Article extraction: Mozilla Readability (Apache-2.0). The voice is synthetic, not a real person's.

welcomeHeadline.message: Don't read the news. Listen to it.

welcomeLead.message: İstima reads Turkish news articles on the sites you visit in a natural voice. Speech is generated by AI entirely on your device: nothing is sent online and it's free.

welcomeSample.message: Merhaba, ben İstima. Gezdiğiniz sitelerdeki Türkçe haberleri sizin için okuyorum. Sayıları, tarihleri ve kısaltmaları da doğru okurum; örneğin 29 Ekim 1923, saat 10:30 ya da TBMM.

welcomeStep1.message: Visit any Turkish news site. İstima extracts the article on its own.

welcomeStep2.message: Click the İstima icon in the toolbar or press Alt+Shift+D. With automatic detection on, the corner “Listen” button works too.

welcomeStep3.message: The current paragraph is highlighted. Change speed, skip paragraphs or switch tabs; reading continues.

welcomePin.message: Click the puzzle icon in the toolbar and pin İstima.

welcomePrivacy.message: No server, no account, no tracking. The text never leaves your computer.

optAutoDetectHint.message: When on, İstima checks every page for a Turkish article on your device and shows the “Listen” button in the corner. Chrome asks for access to all sites for this; no data leaves your device. When off, read from the toolbar icon, the right-click menu or Alt+Shift+D.

welcomeAuto.message: Turn this on and a “Listen” button appears in the corner whenever you open a Turkish article. Chrome asks for access to all sites; the check runs on your device and nothing is sent. Without it, read from the toolbar icon or with Alt+Shift+D.

optModelHint.message: Antalia-2 Mini or EMA Lightning. Both run on your device. Your choice applies to the next reading.
